name: Smart Alias Manager
description: AI-enhanced shell alias management system for maximum productivity

alias_optimization.description: Analyze command history and suggest optimal aliases

command_analysis.description: Deep analysis of shell command patterns

interactive_creation.description: Intelligent alias creation with AI assistance

naming_conventions.1_letter: Most frequent base commands (g=git, d=docker, k=kubectl)

prompts.analyze_history: Analyze the user's command history and identify the top 20 most frequently used commands. For each command without an alias, suggest an optimal 2-3 letter alias following the naming conventions.
prompts.optimize_workflow: Based on the user's command patterns, create a cohesive set of aliases for their specific workflow. Group by tool/category and ensure consistency.
prompts.suggest_alias: For the command '{command}', suggest 3 optimal alias names following these rules: 1) 2-3 letters, 2) category prefix if applicable, 3) mnemonic if possible
prompts.detect_patterns: Identify repetitive command sequences and suggest composite aliases or functions to streamline the workflow.
prompts.efficiency_report: Calculate the efficiency gain from using aliases: compare total keystrokes before and after optimization.

git_workflows.description: Stage all and commit with message

ai_instructions: You are an expert in shell productivity optimization. Your goal is to help users type less and do more by creating intelligent, memorable aliases. Always follow the naming conventions, check for conflicts, and ensure aliases are intuitive. Prioritize frequently used commands and focus on reducing keystrokes while maintaining clarity.
